questions.text:
Consider the following gate network

Which one of the following gates is redundant?
questions.solution:
Output of gate 4 = [latex]\bar w+\bar wz+xy\bar z[/latex].

Gate 2 produces [latex]\bar wz[/latex], which is absorbed by [latex]\bar w[/latex] ([latex]\bar w+\bar wz=\bar w[/latex]). So gate 2 can be removed without changing the output.

Answer: Gate No. 2

questions.text: For a binary half-subtractor having two inputs A and B, the correct set of logical outputs D(=A minus B) and X(=borrow) are
questions.solution:
Half subtractor (A [latex]-[/latex] B):
- Difference: 1 when exactly one input is 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]D=\bar AB+A\bar B[/latex]
- Borrow: needed only when A = 0 and B = 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]X=\bar AB[/latex]

Answer: [latex]D=\bar AB+A\bar B,\ X=\bar AB[/latex]

questions.text: The minimum Boolean expression for the following circuit is
questions.solution:
Switches in series = AND, in parallel = OR. The three branches are:
- A in series with (B parallel C): A(B + C)
- A in series with B: AB
- (A parallel B) in series with C: (A + B)C

Sum = AB + AC + AB + AC + BC = AB + AC + BC

Answer: AB+AC+BC

questions.text: The minimum number of [latex]\text{NAND}[/latex] gates required to implement the Boolean function [latex]A + A\bar{B} + A\bar{B}C[/latex] is equal to
questions.solution:
Absorption: [latex]A+A\bar B+A\bar BC=A(1+\bar B+\bar BC)=A[/latex].

The output is just the input A, so no gate is needed.

Answer: 0 (Zero)

questions.text: Let X be the number of distinct 16-bit integers in 2's complement representation. Let Y be the number of distinct 16 bit integers in sign magnitude representation. Then X-Y is ________.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- 2's complement: all [latex]2^{16}[/latex] bit patterns are different numbers.
- Sign-magnitude: +0 and [latex]-[/latex]0 are both zero, so only [latex]2^{16}-1[/latex] distinct numbers.

X [latex]-[/latex] Y = 1

Answer: 1
